steps.description: logs = pd.read_csv('data/RE3/RE3-OB/cartservice_f1/2/logs.csv'); ta = 1732279831 (the injected 'Incorrect parameter values' fault's anomaly timestamp).
Separate normal logs from multi-line stack traces per container_name and aggregate each into a per-service, per-15s-bucket time series (logs_df), including a cartservice_stack column.
steps.source: code-level-rca.ipynb cell 4-6 ('# 2. Parse logs into time series')

steps.description: from RCAEval.e2e import baro; index logs_df by seconds and call baro(logs_df, ta)['ranks'] to rank candidate root-cause indicators.
BARO ranks cartservice_stack as the top fine-grained root cause indicator, identifying cartservice as the root cause service (confirmed by inspecting its stack-trace logs).
